parsed.rationale: Both participating records are mock types named `MockArtworkService` living inside test targets: one in `Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/NowPlayingServiceTests.swift` and the other in `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkServiceTests.swift`. Test-fixture mocks are intentionally duplicated per test package so that each test suite remains self-contained and independently compilable without cross-test-target dependencies. The Jaccard similarity of 0.75 is consistent with two mocks that stub the same interface but may diverge in recorded call counts, stub return values, or helper assertions specific to each test context. Consolidating them into a shared mock would couple two otherwise independent test targets.
